gateResults.evidence: The final Release owning-repository suite completed across 21 projects with 1,665 tests, 1,631 passed, 0 failed and 34 classified skips; the Search suite and report-rebuild tests also passed.
The separate review approved the aggregate provenance, measured-versus-target boundary, result-unit separation and explicit external residuals; the completion commit carries both required trailers.
Three rebuild contract tests recomputed input hashes and compared published parity, latency, resource and agent facts with their source descriptors and raw records.

The report preserves the observed 12-cell parity result and nine residual cohorts, labels cache state unknown and explicitly withholds a blanket faster-than-rg claim; this is a reporting gate, not complete parity-target qualification.
The report carries the frozen warm-service and cold-client latency targets separately from the three measured in-process cells and records both external boundaries as not_run.
The neutral protocol and hidden holdout are reported with zero completed trials, no leaked answers and no forced Search preference; usability targets remain explicitly unmeasured.

knownLimitations: The nine unmeasured parity cohorts remain explicit residuals; the observed subset does not support a universal faster-than-rg claim.
Cold-client and warm-service latency require external CLI/host ownership and were not run here.

No fresh-context agent runner is available, so first-success, repair, neutral-choice, token and confidence results remain unexecuted; the hidden holdout answers and fixture material remain outside this repository.
Three non-Windows platform profiles and a separate full fuzz engine remain unavailable as recorded by W16-S01.
Filesystem cache state is unknown, and resource memory values remain host-specific observations.
